name: Smokesignal
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. that maintains a mesh network dead-drop system for the unregistered population — people without wallets, without identities, without access to normal communication.
observed_behavior: Routes encrypted text messages through mesh network gaps using signal modulation that standard monitoring cannot detect. Messages between people who officially don't exist.
location: Old Harbor, The Narrows, refugee corridors
story_hooks: Axiom Security detects the shadow network but can't crack it — the encryption changes every time they get close, as if Smokesignal is watching them watch
